# User Service

This service handles user management and related API work.

## Guidelines

- Follow best practices
- Keep code clean and maintainable
- Make sure everything is tested
- Run the linter before submitting changes

## Architecture

The app follows a standard layered structure with handlers, services, and repositories.

## Testing

Run tests to make sure everything works.
Add tests for new behavior.

## Common Issues

- If the database connection fails, retry
- If types are wrong, run the linter
